obs.noticeBody:
In OBS, open the Window Capture properties and set Capture Method to "Windows 10 (1903 and later)".
The default automatic method may show only a black shadow or a black screen.

For a transparent background, also enable "Allow transparency".
If problems persist, enable "Compatibility mode" in Settings to use a solid background with chroma key.
